summary: Built for shooters who value carefully selected components and purposeful design, the Cybex Axiom 6.5 brings together a Kelbly’s Prometheus action, a heavy-profile barrel, and an adjustable competition trigger in a distinctive charcoal green package.
description: Built for shooters who value carefully selected components and purposeful design, the Cybex Axiom 6.5 brings together a Kelbly’s Prometheus action, a heavy-profile barrel, and an adjustable competition trigger in a distinctive charcoal green package.

Chambered in 6.5 Creedmoor, the Axiom features a 26-inch Lothar Walther Heavy Varmint barrel with a 1:8 twist. Its substantial contour tapers from 1.200 inches to .920 inches, while 5/8×24 muzzle threads accommodate compatible muzzle accessories.
A 20-MOA Picatinny rail provides the mounting foundation for your preferred optic.
The TriggerTech Diamond trigger, adjustable from 4 to 32 ounces, lets you tailor trigger pull to your preferences.
An MDT Gen II folding stock completes the configuration, offering the convenience of a folding design for transport and storage.

For an optional optics package, choose the Arken EP-5 5–25×56 scope, featuring a 34mm tube, first focal plane design, and illuminated MIL reticle. Rifles purchased with a scope arrive zeroed at 100 yards using factory ammunition.

name: Bronze Reaper .22lr
summary: Forged for competitors. Refined for marksmen. Built to dominate.
description: Forged for competitors. Refined for marksmen. Built to dominate.

The Bronze Reaper is the embodiment of modern precision rimfire engineering—a rifle designed to blur the line between rimfire training and centerfire performance. At its heart lies the renowned Zermatt RimX action , delivering the smooth cycling, reliability, and consistency that have made it a benchmark among elite precision shooters.

Paired with a hand-selected 23-inch Benchmark match barrel featuring a heavy 1.20″ contour and optimized 1:15 twist, the Bronze Reaper is engineered to produce exceptional accuracy and maintain stability shot after shot.

Every detail of the rifle has been selected with competitive performance in mind. The TriggerTech Diamond trigger , adjustable from an ultra-light 4 ounces to 32 ounces, provides a crisp, glass-rod break that allows the shooter to fully exploit the rifle’s precision potential. Whether engaging KYL racks, tiny PRS Rimfire targets, or challenging positional stages, the trigger delivers confidence when fractions of an inch matter.

The rifle is housed in the flagship MDT Premier Gen II chassis , finished in the distinctive War-Torn Bronze color that inspired its name. More than aesthetics, the chassis incorporates a precision-tuned system of forend weighting, buttstock dampers, and a competition-ready bag rider to create a platform that tracks smoothly, settles quickly, and remains stable through every shot sequence. The result is a rifle that feels planted on barricades, predictable from bags, and exceptionally balanced in the hands.

Topping the system is the Arken EP-5 5-25×56 FFP optic , providing the magnification range and first focal plane precision needed to confidently engage targets from close-range NRL22 stages to the outer limits of rimfire ballistics. The illuminated MIL reticle offers rapid holdovers and precise corrections, ensuring the shooter remains in control regardless of distance or conditions.

Every Bronze Reaper is test-fired, verified, and prepared before delivery, ensuring it arrives ready to perform. More than a rifle, it is a purpose-built precision instrument designed for competitors, trainers, and enthusiasts who refuse to compromise.
The Bronze Reaper doesn’t simply hit targets—it methodically collects them.

name: Hammerhead Pro Match .223
summary: Every once in a while, a rifle comes across the bench that feels less like an assembly of parts and more like a purpose-built instrument. The CF 02-2 is exactly that—a precision-built .223 Remington designed for shooters who demand repeatability, refinement, and uncompromising performance.
description: Every once in a while, a rifle comes across the bench that feels less like an assembly of parts and more like a purpose-built instrument. The CF 02-2 is exactly that—a precision-built .223 Remington designed for shooters who demand repeatability, refinement, and uncompromising performance.

At the heart of this build is the legendary BAT Machine Hammer Head action. Renowned in the precision rifle world for its exceptional rigidity, smooth cycling, and rock-solid consistency, the dual-lug 75° bolt throw design provides the foundation serious accuracy requires. This action was selected for one reason: absolute confidence behind the trigger.

Mated to the action is a 26-inch heavy contour barrel from Krieger Barrels chambered in .223 Remington with a fast 1:8 twist rate. This configuration allows the rifle to stabilize a broad spectrum of bullet weights—from lightweight varmint projectiles to heavy match bullets capable of stretching the cartridge well beyond typical expectations. Enhancing the system further is ACE (Accurize Chamber Enhancement) work performed by Wolf Precision, delivering tighter tolerances and elevated consistency shot after shot.
The barrel is threaded 5/8×24 and fitted with an EC Tuner muzzle brake, allowing the shooter to fine-tune barrel harmonics and recoil impulse for maximum precision.

The trigger system is equally refined. A TriggerTech Diamond trigger adjustable from 4 to 32 ounces provides an exceptionally crisp, clean break with virtually zero creep. Whether shooting from the bench, prone in competition, or engaging targets in the field, the trigger delivers the consistency and control precision shooters expect.

The entire system is housed in an MDT Sporting Goods XRS chassis finished in Flat Dark Earth. Combining the ergonomics of a traditional stock with the modular advantages of a modern chassis system, the XRS offers outstanding shooter comfort and adaptability. This rifle is equipped with the enclosed forend and additional XRS forend weight, creating exceptional balance and stability for prone shooting, barricade work, or long days on the range.

Optional: Topping the package is an Arken Optics EP-5 5-25×56 optic featuring a 34mm tube, first focal plane design, illuminated VHR MIL reticle, and the clarity needed to maximize the rifle’s long-range capability.

The CF 02-2 was never intended to be a safe queen. It was built to perform—whether on the competition line, in a prairie dog town, or on steel at distance. Every component was selected with purpose, and every detail reflects a commitment to precision craftsmanship.

The BR 05-1 “X-Ring Authority” is more than a custom rifle—it is a dedicated precision instrument built for competitors who refuse to compromise. Every component, every contour, and every adjustment exists for one reason: putting rounds exactly where they belong.

The barreled action is Epoxy bedded into a Protektor Model Remington 700-pattern stock configured specifically for the Prometheus action and finished in a rich Coffee color. Proper bedding enhances long-term stability, maintains repeatable harmonics, and ensures the rifle tracks consistently during recoil while preserving the traditional benchrest aesthetic.

For shooters seeking a turnkey precision package, the rifle can optionally be paired with an Arken Optics EP-5 5-25×56 FFP optic mounted in 34mm Monstrum Tactical rings. Featuring a first focal plane illuminated VHR MIL reticle and reliable tracking performance, the EP-5 complements the rifle’s precision-focused mission exceptionally well.
This rifle was built specifically for benchrest competition and precision load development, emphasizing refined ergonomics, mechanical repeatability, and uncompromising accuracy potential.

While classified as a “blem” configuration due to minor cosmetic inconsistencies near the left-side port area, these imperfections are purely cosmetic and have no impact on functionality or performance.

name: Apex Rimfire Precision .22lr (RB/RP)
summary: Born from the discipline of competitive benchrest shooting and shaped by the hands of craftsmen who understand that precision is earned—not claimed—the BR 04-2 is a rimfire rifle built with a singular philosophy: eliminate compromise.
description: Born from the discipline of competitive benchrest shooting and shaped by the hands of craftsmen who understand that precision is earned—not claimed—the BR 04-2 is a rimfire rifle built with a singular philosophy: eliminate compromise.

At its heart lies the legendary PQP Trident action, conceived by Dan Killough and engineered around a 3-lug, 75-degree bolt geometry that cycles with mechanical authority and remarkable smoothness. The RB-RP configuration delivers a short, efficient throw that feels deliberate and exact—every movement refined for the shooter who measures success in thousandths and single-hole groups.

The rifle’s foundation of accuracy is its MullerWorks .920 straight contour barrel, chambered in .22LR and tuned with a 1:16 twist to extract the absolute best from premium match ammunition. Heavy, stable, and thermally consistent, the barrel anchors the rifle with the kind of unwavering balance demanded in serious rimfire competition. Paired with an integrated 20 MOA rail, the BR 04-2 transitions effortlessly from tight benchrest aggregates to precision rimfire engagements at extended distance.

Completing the rifle’s precision-focused architecture is a finely tuned barrel tuner system, engineered to extract the absolute highest level of consistency from match-grade rimfire ammunition. Designed to harmonize barrel vibrations and refine the rifle’s natural frequency during firing, the tuner allows the BR 04-2 to be precisely calibrated to specific ammunition lots and environmental conditions.

Trigger control is delivered through the exceptional TriggerTech Diamond, adjustable from an impossibly light 4 ounces up to 32 ounces. The break is crisp, instantaneous, and devoid of creep—a trigger that disappears beneath the shooter’s finger, leaving only intent and execution.

What truly distinguishes the BR 04-2, however, is its marriage of modern precision with traditional artistry. The rifle is seated in a handcrafted Precision WoodCraft walnut stock by Randy Ownes, built specifically for the Trident platform. Rich walnut grain flows through the stock like topographic contour lines, giving the rifle a timeless elegance rarely seen in contemporary precision builds. It is a rifle equally at home on the firing line or displayed as functional craftsmanship.

Crowning the system is the Arken EP-5 5-25×56, mounted securely in an Area 419 one-piece mount. With its 34mm tube, first focal plane design, illuminated VHR MIL reticle, and repeatable tracking, the optic provides the clarity and confidence necessary for precision shot placement in any condition.

The BR 04-2 is more than a custom rimfire rifle—it is a statement of intent. A rifle for the shooter who understands that excellence is hidden in the smallest details: chamber alignment, trigger break, bolt timing, stock geometry, and the calm certainty that comes from equipment built without shortcuts.
